name: PolyVis
description: PolyVis (Polyglot Vision-Language Alignment) is a multilingual vision-language alignment benchmark designed to evaluate LLM judge models under combined cross-lingual and multimodal constraints. It covers 12 languages and multiple task objectives including hallucinations, safety, knowledge, and reasoning.
reputation: A newer multilingual multimodal alignment benchmark with emerging interest, but not yet a widely established standard.
notes: First benchmark to evaluate LLM judges under multilingual and multimodal settings; reveals performance disparities across languages and tasks.
